preparation: Pure DOPC giant vesicles with 0.1 M sucrose inside and 0.1 M glucose outside. Time starts at the constant aspiration-tension hold. Complete aspiration of an individual vesicle marks rupture.
observable: Mean fitted rate of first rupture per intact vesicle per second. Each repeat fits exponential survival to a cohort.
uncertainty: The figure labels the bars as standard errors across the three experiments. The two cap readings below are coordinates on the log-rate axis. Individual rupture times are unavailable in this figure.
extraction: Read the two common temperature columns from Figure 2a at approximately 3356 and 3279 on the 10^6/T axis (T in kelvin). Calibrate the vertical axis on its -6.0 and -3.5 ticks. At each square, triangle and circle, read the bar caps and use their midpoint for the center. Values are rounded readings of the natural log of a rate in inverse seconds.
